edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber I 19

source_text: Spiritalis intelligentia: osculum est unio Verbi et animae; ubera dogmata utriusque Testamenti; vinum littera occidens; unguentum Spiritus et praedicatio nominis Iesu; tractus gratiae; cellaria theoriae; aequitas puritas cordis sine iniquitate. Qui ad haec nondum aptus est, adulescentula maneat et odorem sequatur, donec osculum perfectum accipiat.
pass_a_gloss: Spiritual understanding: kiss is union of-Word and soul; breasts teachings of-both Testaments; wine letter killing; ointment Spirit and preaching of-name of-Jesus...
pass_b_english: The spiritual sense: the kiss is union of Word and soul; the breasts are the teachings of both Testaments; wine is the killing letter; ointment is the Spirit and the preaching of Jesus’ name; drawing is grace; chambers are contemplation; equity is purity of heart without iniquity. Whoever is not yet fit for these remains a young woman and follows the fragrance until she receives the perfect kiss.
